gates.name: Undefined
gates.criteria: No one has started work on the definition

gates.name: Defined
gates.criteria: Title, description, assignee and references exist

gates.name: Mockup

gates.name: Functional prototype
gates.criteria: A technical demonstration of function exists

gates.name: Design
gates.criteria: A model and sufficient tests exist

gates.name: Implementation
gates.criteria: Artifacts suffice for unit, integration and validation tests

states.synopsis: The work has not yet been defined
The work is proceeding as expected
The work is at risk of stalling

reasons.synopsis: The work waits for its reviewer

marks.junction: Plain; the contributor is a person
Plain; the reviewer accepts the work at the gate
Recursive; another Tableaux project does the work
Not applicable; the entry exempts the task from the gate

findings.kind: A status past a reviewed junction with no review
findings.message: The status stands at 📏 unit and passes 🧱 implementation, whose reviewer is noreply@anthropic.com; no commit carries the trailer `Reviewed: e3cb implementation`. `fbe3c97` writes that line in its body, not among its trailers
findings.action: Review: commit `Reviewed: e3cb implementation`, or return the status to 📐 design, the last reviewed gate
findings.sentence: A validator rejects a status whose gate passes a reviewed junction that has no such commit.

facts.name: Junction
facts.value: `e3cb` at 🧱 implementation takes its contributor noreply@anthropic.com and its model `claude-sonnet` from `437e`. It states no reviewer, so the assignee of `e3cb`, noreply@anthropic.com, reviews.

facts.name: Trailers
facts.value: Git reads a trailer only in the last paragraph of a message. In `fbe3c97` the last paragraph holds `Co-Authored-By:` alone, so the reviewer's line counts for nothing.

commands.text:

commands.comment: resolves it: noreply@anthropic.com, the reviewer, accepts the gate
